_schema.description: Generated by scripts/gap_snapshot.py — do not hand-edit statuses. Lists every gap test that is NOT passing; a test absent from `tests` is expected to pass. CI fails on any divergence in EITHER direction (new failure, or a listed test that now passes). Regenerate with UPDATE_SNAPSHOT=1 ./scripts/run_gap_tests.sh and commit the diff.

fields.issue: GitHub issue tracking this failure, or null when untriaged.
fields.added: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD) the test first entered the snapshot.
fields.category: ci-env | module-inventory | bug-open | bug-stale | gap-categorical | gap-bisect | untriaged — see test-parity/README.md.

test_gap_4510_enum_forward_ref.reason: node --experimental-strip-types refuses this file: ERR_UNSUPPORTED_TYPESCRIPT_SYNTAX, 'TypeScript enum is not supported in strip-only mode'. Fix by giving it a test-parity/expected/<name>.txt fixture (expected-output mode), not by editing the test.
